accessToken.description: Current opaque WhaleU access token. Management and new commands require exact content-bound authority; recovery and cancellation belong to the original actor. Caller-supplied account/profile identifiers and display role labels never grant authority.

info.description: Remove one currently readable native-origin root comment or reply in its original regional scope with sync:none. Named and anonymous content remains content targets only; private authors never become public account locators. Exact school-admin or super-admin grant, phone, Safety, Review, source version and current Media remain required. The selected child alone is tombstoned; a root releases its own comment pin and hides its thread by ancestry, while a reply preserves siblings and references. The canonical component capture and bounded media-cleanup obligation remain independent. Version1 sends no author notification; selected version2 adds a private deletion notice and a separately caused punishment notice. Version1 creates no account punishment; explicit version2 may atomically issue Safety mute or suspension for the exact original author. No owner-deletion Experience, jury verdict, role grant or provider is created. Actor-owned recovery and cancellation need only the same active account and current session token.
